series.name: Portable Hisense AC (not PK retail split/floor line)
series.notes: Portable AC codes (smartacsolutions consumer guide + video-title P1). Not in Tri-Angels PK split/floor lineup; portable P1 water-full ≠ DC inverter P1 — conflict noted.

meaning.en: Internal condensate tank is full; unit shuts off to prevent overflow.
meaning.ur: Andar ka condensate tank bhar gaya hai; unit overflow se bachane ke liye band ho jati hai

causes.en: Tank not drained in humid weather
causes.ur: Nami wale mausam mein tank nahi nikaala gaya

causes.en: Continuous-drain hose not fitted or blocked
causes.ur: Continuous drain hose nahi lagi ya hose band ho gayi hai
Float/water-level sensor par scale jam gaya hai

solutions.en: Remove lower drain plug and empty tank
solutions.ur: Neeche wala drain plug khol kar tank khali karein

solutions.en: Fit continuous-drain hose to floor drain
solutions.ur: Continuous-drain hose ko floor drain par lagayein

solutions.en: Clean float/sensor with diluted white vinegar
solutions.ur: Float/sensor ko pani mein mila hui safed vinegar se saaf karein

source.title: Smart AC Solutions Hisense error codes (consumer guide, portable FL/P1/E9)

notes.ur: Yeh single source (smartac) hai; portable units ki aam riwayat hai.

title.en: Water tank full (portable) / other meanings on splits
title.ur: Pani ka tank bhar gaya (portable) / splits par iske doosre matlab bhi hain

meaning.en: Portable: internal water tank full (same as FL/E9). On some DC inverter splits a video title shows P1 as a different fault — conflict noted, not confirmed.
meaning.ur: Portable: andar ka pani ka tank bhar gaya hai (FL/E9 jaisa hi). Kuch DC inverter split par ek video title P1 ko alag fault dikhata hai — conflict noted, confirm nahi hua.

causes.en: Float switch stuck or sensor dirty
causes.ur: Float switch atka hua hai ya sensor ganda hai

solutions.en: Drain the tank via bottom plug
solutions.ur: Bottom plug se tank ka pani nikaalein

source.title: Smart AC Solutions Hisense error codes (consumer guide, portable FL/P1/E9)

notes.en: Conflict: smartac says P1 = full tank; Fully5world video title "Hisense Dc invelter ac error code P1" (vw3FCttizUA) suggests a split inverter meaning — unverified (title only, low confidence). Research source tag: consumer_guide+video_title.
notes.ur: Conflict: smartac ke mutabiq P1 = full tank; Fully5world video title "Hisense Dc invelter ac error code P1" (vw3FCttizUA) ki nisbat split inverter wali meaning lagti hai — unverified (sirf title, low confidence). Research source tag: consumer_guide+video_title.

meaning.en: On portable units E9 also indicates a full internal water tank (shares meaning with FL/P1).
meaning.ur: Portable unit par E9 bhi andar ke water tank ke bharne ka ishara deta hai (FL/P1 ke sath meaning same hai)

causes.ur: Float sensor ganda ya atka hua hai

solutions.en: Unplug the unit from the mains before working on it, so no power reaches the tank or the float switch.
solutions.ur: Kaam se pehle unit ko mains se nikaal dein taake tank ya float switch tak koi power na pahunche.

solutions.en: Empty the tank through the bottom drain plug (or fit the continuous-drain hose), then rinse and wipe the float chamber.
solutions.ur: Neeche wale drain plug se tank khali karein (ya continuous-drain hose lagayein), phir float chamber ko dho kar saaf kar lein.

solutions.en: If E9 returns with the tank empty, clean the float/level sensor with diluted white vinegar; if it still sticks, replace the float switch.
solutions.ur: Agar tank khali hone ke baad bhi E9 aaye to float/level sensor ko pani mein mila hui safed vinegar se saaf karein; phir bhi atka rahe to float switch badlein.

source.title: Smart AC Solutions Hisense error codes (consumer guide, portable FL/P1/E9)

notes.en: Split-family E9 = outdoor fan motor — context matters (portable vs split).
notes.ur: Split family mein E9 = outdoor fan motor — context ahem hai (portable aur split alag hain).
